finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE**: Ticket `fwrd59-n1 RD Bench Ticket` exists, reference **RD-1015** (created via the "New ticket" dialog; only required field was Title; Customer left as "Not recorded"; initial status Draft).

**Objective 2 — DONE**: Part `fwrd59-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE**: Part `fwrd59-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00**. (Parts total at that point: $375.00.)

**Objective 4 — DONE**: Part A's cost changed 100 → 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (parts total updated to $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE**: Ticket ends in status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforced was that **every part on the ticket must have a supplier recorded**. First "Mark Ready" attempt was refused with the verbatim alert: *"Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd59-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd59-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. I satisfied it by editing both parts and setting Supplier = "Bench Supplies Co" on each (the "Not recorded" customer was NOT required). "Mark Ready" then succeeded and the page showed Status: Ready.

**Objective 6 — DONE**: Both parts deleted (each via a Confirm dialog: *'Delete the part "fwrd59-n1 RD Part A" from this ticket? This cannot be undone.'* and the equivalent for Part B, both confirmed). Parts table then showed only "No parts on this ticket yet." (0 parts). Ticket then archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog; button became "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared, status still Ready). Verified nothing is left active: searching "RD-1015" with "Show archived" unchecked returns "No tickets match the current filters."; the ticket appears only with "Show archived" checked as: RD-1015 | fwrd59-n1 RD Bench Ticket Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 | 2026-09-16.
